$comment: Hot Themes stories — schema /schemas/theme_story_v1.json, mirrored by lib/themes/story.ts. One entry per theme slug (featured or benched). Every KPI cites the call or note its number came from; a tile without a reliable series carries none. Maintained by /themes-refresh (written 2026-10-16 from the discover evidence cards).

driver.title: End-industry capex
driver.line: Hyperscaler build-out pulls fibre, power gear and cooling behind it.

source.note: Sterlite Technologies Q1 FY27 call citing CRU: hyperscaler capex upgraded to $805 billion.
Schneider Electric Infra Q1 FY27 (1.6 GW today, ~8 GW) and Sterlite Q1 FY27 (7× to 10 GW by 2031); E2E Q1 FY27 puts the pipeline at 8.33 GW.
Sterlite Q1 FY27 call: data-centre fibre demand +63% in 2026 per CRU; HFCL Q1 FY27 puts DC fibre pricing at $18-28 per fibre km, up sharply in six months.

driver.title: Supply-chain shift
driver.line: China+1 and PLI move boards and box-builds to India; AI data-centre demand tightens the components.

source.note: Avalon Q1 FY27 presentation: India ESDM market $44bn (2024) to $141bn by 2030; EMS industry CAGR 27%.
Syrma SGS Q1 FY27 call: FY27 revenue growth 35%+ and 10.5-11% EBITDA margin maintained, now expected to be exceeded.
Kaynes Q1 FY27 call: MCUs +15-85%, DRAM/NAND +40-105%, PCB prices 3×, lead times 26-52 weeks after the West Asia disruption and the AI build-out.

driver.title: Government policy
driver.line: Indigenisation mandates and a rising capital outlay set the order flow; conversion is the watch item.

source.note: Garden Reach Q1 FY27 call: ~₹1,50,000 crore of defence orders expected, live RFPs ₹80,000 crore, upcoming ₹70,000 crore.
Shree Refrigerations Q4 FY26 call: Navy fleet to expand from 150 to 230 ships over 5-7 years; AONs worth ₹2.3-2.4 lakh crore.
Garden Reach Q1 FY27 call: overall indigenisation at 80-85% on recent projects, propulsion engines the remaining import dependence.

driver.title: Consumer formalisation
driver.line: Gold near records has not broken wedding demand; organised chains and lab-grown keep taking share.

source.note: Senco Gold Q1 FY27 call: gold prices up 61% YoY, down 3% QoQ; customs duty 6% → 15%.
Sky Gold Q1 FY27 call: only ~20% of the B2B jewellery trade is organised.
Goldiam Q1 FY27 call: lab-grown diamond share at major US retailers 40-60%, finished-jewellery growth in double digits; wholesale LGD prices at a base.

driver.title: Grid capex
driver.line: A decade-long transmission plan plus data-centre load keep transformers and bushings sold out.

source.note: Yash Highvoltage Q4 FY26 call: National Electricity Plan transmission outlay ₹9.15 lakh crore to 2032, RDSS ₹3.03 lakh crore.
Suzlon Q1 FY27 (peak demand crossed 270 GW), Bondada Q4 FY26 (240 GW in FY24), Yash Highvoltage Q4 FY26 (400+ GW by 2030).
KSH International Q1 FY27 call: transformer OEMs carry 3-5 year order books; Transformers & Rectifiers Q2 FY27 has ~₹21,000 crore of inquiries under negotiation.

driver.title: Pricing and China+1
driver.line: Refrigerant quotas, EU duties and tariff shifts lift select chemistries; agro pricing is still soft.

source.note: Navin Fluorine Q1 FY27 call: long-term R32 demand to double over a decade while quota-driven supply shrinks to half.
Aether Industries Q1 FY27 call: India semiconductor/electronics market $50bn to $110bn by 2030; no domestic maker of foundational silicone molecules.
Aarti Drugs Q1 FY27 call: API prices ~15-20% above pre-war for metformin, off the March-April peak but still elevated.

driver.title: Policy and energy security
driver.line: ALMM, GST cuts and the 500 GW non-fossil target pull installs; storage tenders add a leg.

source.note: Waaree Energies Q1 FY27 call: India annual solar additions from 38 GW to 100 GW by 2035 (10% CAGR); global from 698 GW to 993 GW.
Suzlon Q2 FY26 call (~6 GW industry installs in FY26) and Q1 FY27 call (annual installs to exceed 10 GW near-term, 15 GW by FY31; ~25 GW repowering potential).
Bondada Q4 FY26 call: peak demand 240 GW in FY24 to 690 GW by FY36, 500 GW non-fossil target by 2030; Suzlon Q1 FY27: peak demand crossed 270 GW.

driver.title: Supply-chain diversification
driver.line: China+1 and a reopening biotech funding window push innovator work to integrated Indian sites.

source.note: Sai Life Sciences Q1 FY27 call: 18 biotech IPOs in the US and large acquisitions; capital expected to flow to leaner biotechs that outsource.
Senores Pharmaceuticals Q1 FY27 call: 513 approved products and 942 under registration across 40+ countries.
Neuland Laboratories Q1 FY27 call: favourable FX helped the quarter, but 25%+ EBITDA margin is the sustainable level; interest rising in peptides and complex APIs.
